en: Habakkuk 3

p.src: 1  A prayer of Habakkuk, the prophet, set to victorious music.

en: A prayer of Habakkuk, the prophet, set to victorious music.
u.src: 1  A prayer of Habakkuk, the prophet, set to victorious music.

p.src: 2  LORD, I have heard of your fame. I stand in awe of your deeds, LORD. Renew your work in the middle of the years. In the middle of the years make it known. In wrath, you remember mercy.

ja: よ、あなたのみわざに畏れおののく。 この
に、みわざを新たにし、 この
に、それを現してください。 憤りの
にも、あわれみを覚えてください。
en: LORD, I have heard of your fame. I stand in awe of your deeds, LORD. Renew your work in the middle of the years. In the middle of the years make it known. In wrath, you remember mercy.
u.src: 2  LORD, I have heard of your fame. I stand in awe of your deeds, LORD. Renew your work in the middle of the years. In the middle of the years make it known. In wrath, you remember mercy.

p.src: 3  God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.

ja: られた。 セラ。 その
en: God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.
u.src: 3  God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.

p.src: 4  His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his hand, where his power is hidden.

ja: きは日の出のようであり、
が御手から走る。 そこに御
en: His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his hand, where his power is hidden.
u.src: 4  His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his hand, where his power is hidden.

p.src: 5  Plague went before him, and pestilence followed his feet.

en: Plague went before him, and pestilence followed his feet.
u.src: 5  Plague went before him, and pestilence followed his feet.

p.src: 6  He stood, and shook the earth. He looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains were crumbled. The age-old hills collapsed. His ways are eternal.

ja: は揺れた。 主が見渡されると、国々は震えた。 古くからの
々は崩れ落ちた。 その
en: He stood, and shook the earth. He looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains were crumbled. The age-old hills collapsed. His ways are eternal.
u.src: 6  He stood, and shook the earth. He looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains were crumbled. The age-old hills collapsed. His ways are eternal.

p.src: 7  I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction. The dwellings of the land of Midian trembled.

en: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction. The dwellings of the land of Midian trembled.
u.src: 7  I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction. The dwellings of the land of Midian trembled.

p.src: 8  Was the LORD displeased with the rivers? Was your anger against the rivers, or your wrath against the sea, that you rode on your horses, on your chariots of salvation?

ja: よ、川に向かって憤られたのか。 あなたの
けられたのか。 あなたの
けられたのか。 あなたが馬に乗り、 救いの戦車に乗られたのは、そのためか。
en: Was the LORD displeased with the rivers? Was your anger against the rivers, or your wrath against the sea, that you rode on your horses, on your chariots of salvation?
u.src: 8  Was the LORD displeased with the rivers? Was your anger against the rivers, or your wrath against the sea, that you rode on your horses, on your chariots of salvation?

p.src: 9  You uncovered your bow. You called for your sworn arrows. Selah. You split the earth with rivers.

ja: あなたは弓の覆いを取り去り、 誓いによって矢を呼び出された。 セラ。 あなたは
en: You uncovered your bow. You called for your sworn arrows. Selah. You split the earth with rivers.
u.src: 9  You uncovered your bow. You called for your sworn arrows. Selah. You split the earth with rivers.

p.src: 10  The mountains saw you, and were afraid. The storm of waters passed by. The deep roared and lifted up its hands on high.

en: The mountains saw you, and were afraid. The storm of waters passed by. The deep roared and lifted up its hands on high.
u.src: 10  The mountains saw you, and were afraid. The storm of waters passed by. The deep roared and lifted up its hands on high.

p.src: 11  The sun and moon stood still in the sky at the light of your arrows as they went, at the shining of your glittering spear.

en: The sun and moon stood still in the sky at the light of your arrows as they went, at the shining of your glittering spear.
u.src: 11  The sun and moon stood still in the sky at the light of your arrows as they went, at the shining of your glittering spear.

p.src: 12  You marched through the land in wrath. You threshed the nations in anger.

en: You marched through the land in wrath. You threshed the nations in anger.
u.src: 12  You marched through the land in wrath. You threshed the nations in anger.

p.src: 13  You went out for the salvation of your people, for the salvation of your anointed. You crushed the head of the land of wickedness. You stripped them head to foot. Selah.

ja: き、 その全身を頭から足までさらけ出された。 セラ。
en: You went out for the salvation of your people, for the salvation of your anointed. You crushed the head of the land of wickedness. You stripped them head to foot. Selah.
u.src: 13  You went out for the salvation of your people, for the salvation of your anointed. You crushed the head of the land of wickedness. You stripped them head to foot. Selah.

p.src: 14  You pierced the heads of his warriors with their own spears. They came as a whirlwind to scatter me, gloating as if to devour the wretched in secret.

ja: を、 彼ら自身の槍で
らは私を散らそうと、つむじ
のように押し寄せ、 ひそかに
くすかのように、勝ち誇っていた。
en: You pierced the heads of his warriors with their own spears. They came as a whirlwind to scatter me, gloating as if to devour the wretched in secret.
u.src: 14  You pierced the heads of his warriors with their own spears. They came as a whirlwind to scatter me, gloating as if to devour the wretched in secret.

p.src: 15  You trampled the sea with your horses, churning mighty waters.

ja: みつけ、 大水をかき乱された。
en: You trampled the sea with your horses, churning mighty waters.
u.src: 15  You trampled the sea with your horses, churning mighty waters.

p.src: 16  I heard, and my body trembled. My lips quivered at the voice. Rottenness enters into my bones, and I tremble in my place because I must wait quietly for the day of trouble, for the coming up of the people who invade us.

ja: えた。 われわれを侵す民が攻め上る
en: I heard, and my body trembled. My lips quivered at the voice. Rottenness enters into my bones, and I tremble in my place because I must wait quietly for the day of trouble, for the coming up of the people who invade us.
u.src: 16  I heard, and my body trembled. My lips quivered at the voice. Rottenness enters into my bones, and I tremble in my place because I must wait quietly for the day of trouble, for the coming up of the people who invade us.

p.src: 17  For even though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines, the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food, the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls,

ja: がならず、 オリーブの
en: For even though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines, the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food, the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls,
u.src: 17  For even though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines, the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food, the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls,

p.src: 18  yet I will rejoice in the LORD. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!

en: yet I will rejoice in the LORD. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
u.src: 18  yet I will rejoice in the LORD. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!

p.src: 19  GOD, the Lord, is my strength. He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music director, on my stringed instruments.

en: GOD, the Lord, is my strength. He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music director, on my stringed instruments.
u.src: 19  GOD, the Lord, is my strength. He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music director, on my stringed instruments.

ja: 3:19 「主」と訳された言葉は「アドナイ」である。
en: 3:19 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.”
